signal: PlanSource unveiled an evolved brand in January 2026 and launched Delivery Hub, an AI-powered tool that automates and de-risks benefits administration configuration

email.body1:
Bill, saw PlanSource roll out the rebrand and launch Delivery Hub to automate benefits configuration.

A relaunch and new product open conversations across brokers and HR teams, usually more accounts in-market than the sales team can cover at once. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for PlanSource off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Bill, quick follow-up for PlanSource.

A rebrand and AI launch spike interest, but most teams can't tell how many of those prospects they're actually touching, so it converts at a fraction of its potential. The gap shows up before open-enrollment season, late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your team needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Bill, last bit of proof for PlanSource.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how PlanSource's reply rate likely compares to peer HR-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Bill, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A rebrand and new AI launch is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an HR-tech motion? I'll tailor it to PlanSource either way.
